files.description: Shop price list (64 rows): sku (text code such as "PL-0007"), item (product name with size; several names have accented letters), section (dairy, pantry, drinks or bakery; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), price (written with exactly two decimals, e.g. "9.50"; no empty cells).

task_text: Prepare the price list for a label printer: every text column must be in upper case with no spaces around the values; numbers stay unchanged. `result` should be the cleaned table with the same columns, sorted by sku.
intended_computation: Strip and upper-case sku, item and section, keep price as it is, and return all 64 rows with the four columns sorted by sku ascending.

acceptable_variants.notes: the row index may be 0..63 or carried over from the file.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the selection of object-typed columns is empty, so the text is printed unchanged

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
